title: Framework master Advanced CodeQL uploads fail while GitHub Default Setup remains enabled
title_de: Framework-master-Advanced-CodeQL-Uploads scheitern bei aktiviertem GitHub Default Setup
observed_behavior: On resulting Framework master 6de40c1714410241e917e9083ee890a82fb2fdbb, trusted Advanced CodeQL completed with failure for Actions, C/C++, and Python. All languages extracted and analyzed source, but GitHub rejected SARIF processing because Default Setup is enabled. The three separate Default Setup analyses on the same SHA succeeded. A later read-only observation of externally advanced master 8572da580e11bc3c62f6ef559152f49b30650056 reports Default Setup as not configured and three successful Advanced CodeQL jobs. Neither external configuration transition nor later master commits were made by this task; they do not retroactively turn the exact 6de40c result into a pass or establish the user-authorized selected configuration.
observed_behavior_de: Auf dem resultierenden Framework-master 6de40c1714410241e917e9083ee890a82fb2fdbb endete Trusted Advanced CodeQL für Actions, C/C++ und Python mit Fehler. Alle Sprachen extrahierten und analysierten den Source, aber GitHub lehnte die SARIF-Verarbeitung ab, weil Default Setup aktiviert ist. Die drei getrennten Default-Setup-Analysen auf demselben SHA bestanden. Eine spätere nur lesende Beobachtung des extern weitergelaufenen Masters 8572da580e11bc3c62f6ef559152f49b30650056 meldet Default Setup als nicht konfiguriert und drei erfolgreiche Advanced-CodeQL-Jobs. Weder dieser externe Konfigurationswechsel noch die späteren Master-Commits wurden von diesem Task vorgenommen; sie machen das exakte Ergebnis von 6de40c nicht rückwirkend zu einem Pass und belegen nicht die nutzerautorisierte gewählte Konfiguration.
expected_behavior: Only one compatible CodeQL configuration uploads each master language, and the selected trusted workflow completes successfully without weakening or misrepresenting a security control.
expected_behavior_de: Nur eine kompatible CodeQL-Konfiguration lädt jede Master-Sprache hoch, und der gewählte vertrauenswürdige Workflow endet ohne Abschwächung oder falsches Darstellen eines Security-Controls erfolgreich.
impact: The exact PR #27 resulting-master Advanced uploader cannot be claimed to have succeeded, so its required master verification remains historically failed. Later external master state currently permits Advanced CodeQL, but without an explicit owner decision it cannot establish that the selected Code Scanning configuration is intentional, durable, or authorized.
impact_de: Der Advanced-Uploader auf dem exakten resultierenden Master von PR #27 kann nicht als erfolgreich bezeichnet werden; seine erforderliche Master-Verifikation bleibt daher historisch fehlgeschlagen. Der spätere externe Master-Zustand erlaubt Advanced CodeQL derzeit, aber ohne eine ausdrückliche Owner-Entscheidung belegt er nicht, dass die gewählte Code-Scanning-Konfiguration absichtlich, dauerhaft oder autorisiert ist.
preconditions: Default Setup is configured for actions, c-cpp, and python.
The trusted workflow runs on push to master with upload: always.

evidence.command: rtk gh run view 29701466354 --repo Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework --log-failed; rtk gh api repos/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework/commits/6de40c1714410241e917e9083ee890a82fb2fdbb/check-runs --paginate; rtk gh api 'repos/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework/code-scanning/analyses?ref=refs/heads/master&tool_name=CodeQL&per_page=100'
evidence.summary: All three Advanced CodeQL language uploads were rejected after analysis because Default Setup is enabled; the three Default Setup analyses for the same master SHA succeeded.

evidence.command: rtk gh api repos/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework/code-scanning/default-setup --jq '{state,languages,query_suite,updated_at}'; rtk gh api repos/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework/commits/8572da580e11bc3c62f6ef559152f49b30650056/check-runs --paginate
evidence.summary: After external master advancement, GitHub readback reports Default Setup state not-configured and terminal-success Advanced CodeQL jobs for actions, c-cpp, and python. The task neither changed this setting nor authored the later master commits; the current configuration still lacks an explicit authorized disposition.

root_cause: GitHub Default Setup and the repository-owned trusted Advanced CodeQL workflow are both configured to upload CodeQL results for the same master languages. GitHub rejects Advanced SARIF processing while Default Setup remains enabled.
root_cause_de: GitHub Default Setup und der repositoryeigene vertrauenswürdige Advanced-CodeQL-Workflow sind beide dafür konfiguriert, CodeQL-Ergebnisse für dieselben Master-Sprachen hochzuladen. GitHub lehnt die Advanced-SARIF-Verarbeitung ab, solange Default Setup aktiviert bleibt.
proposed_remediation: Choose and prove one authorized configuration through a new reviewed normal Framework PR: disable Default Setup and retain the reviewed Advanced uploader, or redesign/remove the Advanced uploader while retaining independently verified compatible scanning. Do not direct-push master, bypass controls, weaken permissions, suppress failures, or change Parent/MRTS.
proposed_remediation_de: Eine autorisierte Konfiguration über einen neuen geprüften normalen Framework-PR wählen und belegen: Default Setup deaktivieren und den geprüften Advanced-Uploader behalten oder den Advanced-Uploader neu gestalten/entfernen, während unabhängig verifiziertes kompatibles Scanning erhalten bleibt. Keinen direkten Master-Push, keinen Control-Bypass, keine Permission-Abschwächung, keine Failure-Unterdrückung und keine Parent-/MRTS-Änderung vornehmen.
acceptance_criteria: The selected configuration is explicitly authorized and read back from GitHub.
All applicable CodeQL jobs upload processable results for one exact resulting master SHA.
The Code Scanning API shows actions, c-cpp, and python coverage for that SHA without an upload-processing failure.
No security setting, workflow permission, test, Parent gitlink, or MRTS boundary is weakened as a workaround.
validation_plan: Open a dedicated normal Framework PR for the selected configuration.
Verify exact PR-head reviews, checks, and CodeQL behavior.
Merge only with current explicit master authorization and exact-head binding.
Read back exact master check runs, logs, Default Setup state, Code Scanning analyses, and alerts.
regression_tests: Exact-master Default Setup CodeQL analyses for actions, c-cpp, and python
legitimate_control_tests: Default Setup Analyze actions/c-cpp/python succeeded on the exact master SHA.
The Code Scanning alerts endpoint reports zero open alerts on master.
The trusted workflow retains job-scoped security-events: write and no pull_request trigger.
dependencies: Authorized GitHub Code Scanning configuration decision
blocked_by: The later externally observed Default Setup transition to not-configured is not an explicit authorized configuration disposition and contradicts the earlier retain-Default-Setup decision for PR #27.

The exact PR #27 resulting-master Advanced upload failure at 6de40c1714410241e917e9083ee890a82fb2fdbb remains historical evidence and is not retroactively converted to a pass by later external master state.

history.detail: PR #27 was squash-merged at 6de40c1714410241e917e9083ee890a82fb2fdbb. GitHub run 29701466354 completed failure for Actions, C/C++, and Python after analysis because Advanced CodeQL SARIF uploads cannot be processed while Default Setup is enabled. Dynamic Default Setup analyses for the same SHA all completed success; no open Code Scanning alerts were observed.

After PR #27, external commits advanced Framework master to 8572da580e11bc3c62f6ef559152f49b30650056. Read-only GitHub API state reports Default Setup not-configured and terminal-success Advanced CodeQL actions, c-cpp, and python jobs for that later SHA. This task made neither the setting transition nor the later master commits. The original exact-SHA failure remains retained, and a current authorized configuration choice is still required before verification or closure.

The current user explicitly accepted this exact residual risk for local archive disposition. The unselected/unverified CodeQL configuration transition remains explicit; no settings, workflow, check, or external control changed and no technical closure is claimed.
